title: A flaw in Node.js HTTP Agent connection reuse can cause a client to accept as valid a response that was sent before…
description: A vulnerability in Node.js HTTP Agent connection reuse can cause a client to accept a response that was sent before, potentially leading to incorrect or unexpected behavior. This flaw relates to improper handling of HTTP connection reuse in the affected version 3.0 of the product. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
